title: 5 Offbeat Hidden Gems in Andaman and Nicobar Islands You Haven't Heard Of
summary: Ditch the crowds and explore these secret locations, pristine lakes, and untouched villages in Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
content: While major sights draw crowds, the true magic of Andaman and Nicobar Islands lies in its off-the-beaten-path locations. In this guide, we take you off the tourist grid to explore serene forests, secret waterfalls, and ancient local temples. We reveal spots like Jolly Buoy Island Corals and Barren Island Active Volcano that have preserved their raw natural beauty and tribal culture, offering perfect retreats for solo backpackers and nature lovers.
